Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Hawaiian woman, an adult, in her mid 20s, a tired, faintly beaten look, her gaze dropping and her mouth softening, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest — and below it, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projecting forward from her long, powerful torso, its surface taut and round, with a slight inward taper still visible at her waist on either side of the belly. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, twin-tail hair, real pores, real living eyes, 200 hoops piercings set with amethysts in mixed metal-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of platinum a ring. Full body painted in Klimt-inspired organic mosaic, an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the pattern reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps, wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of organic curved mosaic wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's natural centrepiece, the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. The paint has worn thin in broad patches over her upper back, hips and calves and chipped off in small flakes at her wrists and ankles, the living skin showing through the faded pattern. Soot darkens her nose, cheeks and chin, damp strands of hair stick to her cheeks and neck, dirt is ground into her knees, calves and elbows, and her bare feet are filthy with dust and dirt. Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a long thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, that runs back along her sides to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball dragging on the flagstones behind her, the chains pulled taut by its weight so her arms are drawn back. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links. Pose: walking slowly, her body turned in profile to the camera and her face turned toward the camera, leaning forward against the pull with her arms drawn back along her sides to the chains, the iron ball dragging on the flagstones behind her, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining with fatigue, her pregnant belly, chest and shoulders in view, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her bare feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. Lighting: dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Her pregnant belly is the visible centerpiece of the frame. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
